systems.system: SASSA biometric enrolment and verification (fingerprint at local offices; electronic facial biometric on online portals)
systems.tiers: SASSA local offices and online application portals; 997,379 beneficiaries verified at local offices from September 2025 to 2026-03-11; facial check relies on the biometric image captured by Home Affairs at Smart ID application

note: Social grant biometric verification; nothing on civil registration.
